what: Broadens the M100 columnar CustomScan to admit GROUP BY+WHERE combined, avg(float8), and sum(int2/int4) byte-identical to the native plan; declines the numeric-output shapes (avg(int*), sum(int8), sum(float4)/avg(float4)) to the native plan. Byte-identical strategy from the blueprint (PG docs E1, DataFusion 54 sum.rs/average.rs E2/E3, Citus rettype pattern E5): sum(int2/4)->bigint=Arrow Int64 (no overflow), avg(float8)->float8=Arrow Float64; agg_datum emits the PG output type per AggSpec variant.
hardware: DigitalOcean c-8 (8 vCPU CPU-Optimized dedicated), PostgreSQL 17.10 + pgrx 0.19.0, shared_buffers=2GB, work_mem=256MB

dataset.cols: k int (100 groups), x float8, i4 int4, i2 int2, b int8, f4 real

reproduce: benchmarks/columnar_aggregate_ab.py (SET theodb.enable_columnar_agg on/off; scalar value or full grouped result set compared columnar vs heap; EXPLAIN decline check for numeric-output shapes)
goal: admit GROUP BY+WHERE, avg(float8), sum(int2/int4) byte-identical to native; decline numeric-output shapes
verdict: GOAL MET. GROUP BY+WHERE, avg(float8), sum(int2/int4) admitted byte-identical, 6.58x-12.99x faster; numeric-output shapes decline to the native plan (exact result). Byte-fidelity scoping per blueprint, not a defect.
caveats: GROUP BY+WHERE needs a pushable predicate (else native, unpruned). Warm regime; speedup GUC-on vs GUC-off same table. The pre-existing M100 composability limitation is M115, not M114.
